message:
Let me check if there's a pre-built binary or if I need to build it. Let me also check if there are any existing HDF5 test files I can use as a base:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>find /workspace -name "*.h5" -o -name "h5_extended_fuzzer" 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
